test_title: SSC Stenographer 2025 Official Paper (Held On: 06 Aug, 2025 Shift 1)
subject: general
question: In a certain code, A + B means A is the mother of B, A x B means A is the father of B, A - B means A is the sister of B, what does P x Q - R mean?

options.text: P is the father of Q and Q is the sister of R
Q is the sister of R and Q is the sister of R
R is the father of P and Q is the sister of R
P is the brother of R and Q is the sister of R

solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/aecbe9ab6b7da7cca1ac2d356e84b8c992ce57c8b50affd73dfdd3dad30ceb2e.png] 

Decoding symbols:

Given: P x Q - R

P x Q → P is the father of Q.

Q - R → Q is the sister of R.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4dce517c9d5ece81982495f751185f94241819f449615a0b45ab2706cd57fe5a.png] 

Thus, P is the father of Q and Q is the sister of R

Hence, the correct answer is "Option 1"
